Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Rohan - 10 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anjali - 35 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Naira - 8 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
4. Siya - 9 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Anjali and Siya stand near him.]

Rohan: "Today feels like a good day."

[Rohan bursts out laughing.]

Rohan (laughing): "Siya, listen!"

[Rohan gets frightened and steps back.]

Anjali: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Rohan stands in the park. Anjali stands near him.]

Rohan: "So, here we are!"

[Rohan plays cricket in the park.]

Rohan: "Yes, all right."

[Rohan swings on the swing.]

Rohan: "This is amazing!"

[Rohan goes down the slide.]

Anjali: "Good job, Rohan!"

[Rohan plays with his dog.]

Rohan: "Mom, look at this."

[Rohan feeds the birds.]

Rohan (surprised): "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 3: The kitchen - Day

[Rohan stands in the kitchen. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "So, here we are!"

[Rohan chops onions for the curry.]

Rohan: "That's great!"

[Rohan washes the dishes after dinner.]

Rohan (gently): "What a day to remember!"
